summary: Iteration 14: Tested AttendanceAdmin live-board, monthly register, demo seeder (seed/wipe). All 13 backend pytests pass. Frontend 6-tab page (Today's Board, Monthly Register, Shifts, Assignments, Sites, Demo) loads and works end-to-end with HR login hr@acme.io. Seed count=5 years=1 showed 'Seed complete' green card. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: demo_data_routes.py is 377 lines — acceptable but approaching the threshold; consider splitting pools (names/titles/cities) into a fixtures module if it grows.
seed uses global random without seed argument — output is non-deterministic; harmless for demo but cannot reproduce exact data for bug repro.
register endpoint loads ALL approved leaves for the company (no date filter on leaves.find) — could grow slow on large tenants; consider filtering by start/end overlap with month range.
live-board caps employees.to_list(5000) and attendance.to_list(5000) — will silently truncate for very large tenants; consider pagination or unbounded cursor iteration with a warning log.
reset=true in seed uses regex on email '^demo[0-9]+@' for users — fine; wipe-demo regex identical. Confirmed consistent.
test_credentials: HR: hr@acme.io / Hr@12345 (worked). Employee: employee@acme.io / Employee@123 (used for 403 negative test, worked).
seed_data_creation: Tests create/wipe their own DEMO* employees (5×1 and 50×2). Final state: wiped clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration14_attendance_demo.py covers live-board (HR+403), monthly register (grid codes), seeder (role-gate, seed 5x1, idempotency dup-key, 50x2 perf <90s, wipe, param validation). Seed 50x2 completed in ~1-3s on this box. All endpoints stable.
perf_notes: seed count=50 years=2 completes well under 90s. count=5 years=1 returns in ~1s.
